0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4""".strip().split("\n")],dtype=float)
idx={a:i for i,a in enumerate(aas)}
def sw(a,b,go=11.0,ge=1.0):
    ai=[idx.get(c,0) for c in a]; bi=np.array([idx.get(c,0) for c in b])
    m=len(bi); H=np.zeros(m+1); E=np.zeros(m+1); best=0.0
    for i in range(len(ai)):
        row=b62[ai[i]][bi]; Hp=H; H=np.zeros(m+1); F=0.0
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            e=E[j]-ge; hp=Hp[j]-go; E[j]=e if e>hp else hp
            f=F-ge; hl=H[j-1]-go; F=f if f>hl else hl
            v=Hp[j-1]+row[j-1]
            if E[j]>v: v=E[j]
            if F>v: v=F
            if v<0: v=0.0
            H[j]=v
            if v>best: best=v
    return best
def fa(acc): return requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n",1)[1].replace("\n","")
mtl3=fa("O94317")
targets={"mtl2 (O13695)\nS. pombe Mid2-like sensor":"O13695",
         "pfl2 (Q8TFG9)\nS. pombe GPI flocculin-like":"Q8TFG9",
         "adg2 (O13854)\nS. pombe Ser/Thr-rich":"O13854",
         "SPBPB18E9.04c (Q8TFG4)\nS. pombe Ser-rich":"Q8TFG4",
         "B6JVK2\nS. japonicus Ser-rich GPI-like":"B6JVK2",
         "ScMtl1 (P53214)\nS. cerevisiae CWI sensor":"P53214"}
rs=np.random.RandomState(1)
res=[]
for lab,acc in targets.items():
    t=fa(acc); t=t[:700]
    o=sw(mtl3,t)
    nl=[]
    for k in range(8):
        s=list(t); rs.shuffle(s); nl.append(sw(mtl3,"".join(s)))
    nl=np.array(nl); z=(o-nl.mean())/nl.std(ddof=1)
    res.append(dict(target=lab,acc=acc,obs=o,null_mean=nl.mean(),null_sd=nl.std(ddof=1),Z=z))
    print(f"{acc}: obs {o:.0f} null {nl.mean():.0f}+-{nl.std(ddof=1):.0f}  Z={z:.2f}")
R=pd.DataFrame(res).sort_values("Z")
R.to_csv("/tmp/sw_z.csv",index=False)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8.5,4.5))
ax.barh(R.target, R.Z, color=["#b0b0b0" if z<5 else "#2e7d32" for z in R.Z])
ax.axvline(5, ls="--", c="crimson", lw=1)
ax.text(5.15, -0.4, "Z = 5 (conventional homology threshold)", color="crimson", fontsize=8, va="bottom")
ax.set_xlabel("Smith-Waterman Z score vs composition-preserving shuffled null (BLOSUM62, gap 11/1)")
ax.set_title("mtl3 (O94317) shows no composition-corrected sequence similarity\nto the Mid2-like sensors it is named after, or to any other Ser/Thr-rich protein tested")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print(R.to_string(index=False))
